Leah (sec): FYI image signing started failing in the staging canary after the midnight key rotation. Looks like the rotation job removed an auxiliary binding that our build pipeline relied on. Posting here to coordinate quick mitigation + follow-up.
Owen (eng-infra): on it. I saw the rotation job finish at 00:03 and there was a cleanup step that pruned 'legacy-build-sa' bindings. Might have been overzealous.
Priya (eng-runtime): what symptom are we seeing in the canary?
Leah (sec): cosign client failed with: ```cosign: upload failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request missing permission cloudkms.cryptoKeys.encrypt```
Dmitri (sre): that confirms it got to KMS. Can we confirm which service account attempted the call?
kms-bot: [automated] Denied KMS calls (2) for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/signing-v2. Callers: build-runner-7 (serviceAccount:legacy-build-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com), ad-hoc canary-runner. First denied at 1717990902.
Owen (eng-infra): audit diff shows the rotation script removed a binding block: ```- members:\n  - serviceAccount:legacy-build-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\n  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter```
Priya (eng-runtime): we can switch the canary to a fallback signing key (non-prod) to keep deployments moving. But we should not restore wide perms without a TTL.
Leah (sec): agreed. Two-parter: (1) short-term: enable scoped binding for current build-sa to the signing key so canary succeeds; (2) longer-term: make the rotation script safer and add preflight checks in CI.
Owen (eng-infra): I'll apply a key-scoped binding for `build-sa@redwood-prod` now. Will annotate as "emergency temporary grant". We should use an IAM condition limiting by request.time or by binding to the runner principal, but our tooling doesn't support automatic TTL revoke yet.
Priya (eng-runtime): when you re-grant, please scope it to `resource.name == "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/signing-v2"` in the condition and set an annotation so ops can revoke after canary. Also I'll flip the canary to `--annotations canary=true` so we can filter traces.
Dmitri (sre): I'll stand up monitoring: create an alert for KMS PERMISSION_DENIED spikes and post to #eng-security with runbook steps.
Owen (eng-infra): applying change now.
kms-bot: [automated] IAM change: added roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to serviceAccount:build-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com on key signing-v2 at 1717991205 by owen.
Owen (eng-infra): done. Left a PR comment in infra repo: "temporary restore to unblock canary; follow-up to tighten rotation script and add automated revoke."
Priya (eng-runtime): kicked off a canary sign using fallback key first to validate pipeline, then switched to signing-v2 after bind — cosign: signature upload OK.
Dmitri (sre): Splunk got two KMS denied events and the subsequent allow — indexed under security.kms. Creating incident channel `#inc-key-rotation-safety` and adding runbook checklist.
Leah (sec): follow-ups: 1) add a CI preflight `verify_kms_binding.sh` that queries key IAM and aborts early if missing; 2) add rotation script unit tests and a dry-run step; 3) create an automation ticket for ephemeral grants (ideally via short-lived credentials with KMS logging hooks); 4) update rotation playbook to exclude build service accounts unless explicitly approved.
Owen (eng-infra): i'll open PRs: one for the preflight script, one to add a dry-run mode to rotation tool. Will tag infra leads.
Priya (eng-runtime): i'll add canary-only annotation handling and a quick fail-fast in the runtime so we don't propagate unverified images.
Dmitri (sre): proposing an alert rule: if KMS.PERMISSION_DENIED > 1 in 15m -> notify #eng-security and create an incident stub.
Leah (sec): also tagging compliance to make sure audit events for the temporary grant are retained. kms-bot: please forward the IAM change + denied events to the SIEM.
kms-bot: [automated] forwarded 4 events (IAM delta + KMS denies) to siem at 1717991502.
Owen (eng-infra): noted. I'll add the IAM diff and PR link to the incident channel.
Leah (sec): thanks team. No customer impact, closing when PRs merged and preflight is in CI. Will add short blameless note to weekly security sync. :white_check_mark:
